latest_release.name: v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release adds project and system backups that include volumes, group-based RBAC with resource-level permissions, and an opt-in mode for auto-update and auto-heal. It also fixes bugs across image updates, GitOps sync, and permission checks, and improves performance for image update scans and page loads.

### Backups
- Back up and restore projects with their volumes (#4995) by @neurekadev
- Export and import projects with their volumes (#4888) by @neurekadev
- Schedule project backups per project or globally (#4996) by @neurekadev
- Back up Arcane only in system backups (#4997) by @neurekadev
- Discover local backups after Arcane's data volume is lost (#4966) by @neurekadev
- Retry locked project snapshots during GitOps backup (#5044) by @kmendell
- Route project export, import, and transfer through the shared backup capture (#4999) by @neurekadev
- Route volume backup and restore through the shared backup engine (#5000) by @neurekadev
- Route Arcane backup and restore through the shared backup engine (#5001) by @neurekadev
- Keep all backup schedules in the shared policy table (#5002) by @neurekadev

### Access Control
- Add user groups and group role assignments (#5028) by @kmendell
- Add resource-level permissions and edge forwarding (#5029) by @kmendell
- Add OIDC/LDAP group claim mappings and a project picker (#5030) by @kmendell
- Check upgrade permission in every environment an upgrade job targets (#4979) by @kmendell
- Require permission in every environment for multi-environment actions (#4980) by @kmendell
- Explain permission errors when project files are not writable (#5043) by @kmendell

### Image Updates and Registries
- Add opt-in mode for auto-update and auto-heal (#4947) by @Tim-Sc
- Speed up image update scanning across registries (#4970) by @kmendell
- Reuse digests and cache registry auth during update checks (#4972) by @kmendell
- Skip update tags that have no matching platform (#4991) by @kmendell
- Update projects from webhooks and the CLI only when a new image exists (#4982, #4985) by @neurekadev
- Cap the daemon digest fallback to half the remaining deadline (#5023) by @kmendell
- Report rejected registry credentials as bad requests (#4968) by @kmendell
- Skip pulling images that Compose builds produce (#4953) by @kmendell
- Update image tag variables in .env instead of rewriting compose.yaml (#5009) by @neurekadev
- Update follower services when an image variable changes (e93232a) by @kmendell

### GitOps and Projects
- Harden webhook pagination, volume restores, and sync error handling (#4912) by @kmendell
- Skip GitOps sync runs when the remote branch is unchanged (#4969) by @kmendell
- Allow bidirectional GitOps sync without an existing project (#4987) by @kmendell
- Clone build git refs, including tags, custom refs, and SHAs (#4950) by @kmendell
- Support labeled project URLs in x-arcane.urls (#4931) by @kmendell
- Create .env and override files from the file dialog (#4956) by @kmendell
- Send only changed project files on save (#5008) by @TRPostma
- Stop blocking Compose updates on schema validation errors (#5019) by @kmendell
- Include restart dependents when namespacing Compose projects (#5046) by @kmendell
- Render markdown files in workspace views (#5011) by @neurekadev

### Containers and UI
- Add container terminal user and automatic shell selection (#4936) by @kmendell
- Pretty-print well-known container and service labels (#4941) by @kmendell
- Show Swarm task hostnames in the container list (#5012) by @martincortina
- Add a build history shortcut to the build image page (#5014) by @huzky-v
- Add missing bulk image pull and project destroy actions (#4914) by @kmendell
- Show one summary toast for batched update results (#4937) by @kmendell
- Show the first error in bulk action toasts (#5022) by @kmendell
- Send Slack notifications through the shoutrrr service (#4938) by @kmendell
- Move the update banner click handler to the tooltip trigger (#4935) by @kmendell
- Stop projec
